__comment: Trust policy for the rentez-ci-deploy role: who may assume it, as opposed to
ci-deploy-policy.json which says what it may then do. `aws iam create-role`
requires this and there is no default, so the role cannot be created without it.
Replace <ACCOUNT_ID> with the AWS account the role lives in, and
<ENVIRONMENT_NAME> with the GitHub Environment that holds its
The `sub` condition is scoped to one Environment rather than the whole
repository. With per-member AWS accounts that scoping is what keeps the
accounts separate: a run bound to someone else's Environment presents a
different `sub` and cannot assume this role, so a teammate's deploy cannot
spend your budget. Widen it to repo:OWNER/REPO:* only for an account the
whole team is meant to share.
Remove this __comment key before use; IAM rejects unknown top-level keys.
